source.name: Encyclopedia of Indianapolis: Lucas Oil Stadium
source.quote: Naming rights were announced on February 28, 2006. Lucas Oil Products, a California-based manufacturer and distributor of automotive oil, additives, and lubricants, secured the sponsorship for $122 million over 20 years.

note: Stadium naming rights: Lucas Oil Stadium. A 20-year term from February 2006 would run to 2026; no source for an extension or the deal's end, so 'to' is left null.
